text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Forgetting something is seriously 
the worst... And why the hell is it so 
dark out here anyway...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I-I'm fine. That was just the wind 
blowing...! ...Right? Ghosts don't 
normally show up, right...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wha!!?? I-I didn't hear anything...!! I 
didn't hear a single word just now!! I 
swear I heard nothing...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after fleeing straight home... 
Espoir City still felt as though she could 
hear "someone's" voice...
